_readme: Certifications and published specification data for the exit-device makers a North
American buyer compares us against. Collected 2026-09-10 after buyers arrived carrying
1. Every claim is transcribed from the source listed on its own row. Nothing is
inferred from a sibling product or a family page.
2. `holds` is what the source states that manufacturer holds. It is NOT a list of
things we may claim. Our own row is `canton-hyland` and it is deliberately short.
3. Where a source did not state something, the field is absent rather than empty or
guessed. An absent field means 'not established', not 'does not have'.
Regenerate the report with: node scripts/build-competitor-matrix.mjs

notes: Fire-rated variants are ordered by adding an -F suffix; the fire listing belongs to that configuration, not to the series.

holds: UL and cUL panic exit listing (FVSR / FVSR7)
UL fire exit hardware listing on -F variants (GXHX / GXHX7), 3 hour
publishes: ANSI Function 01 — exit only, no trim
Fire listing sizes: 4' x 8' single, 8' x 8' pairs

makers.madeIn: not stated by the sources consulted
makers.series: 9800 / A9800 / F9800 rim and surface vertical rod
holds: UL and ULC listed for panic
UL fire rated up to 3 hours (F variants)
publishes: Brass, bronze or stainless rail assemblies and end caps
notes: Closest commercial analogue to our position: a US brand competing on Grade 1 certification rather than on being American-made. Country of manufacture is not published, which is itself informative — the certification is what is sold, not the origin.

makers.series: Exit control locks and exit devices
notes: The only maker in this set publishing the two REGIONAL approvals: California SFM and Miami-Dade NOA. Both are gates on real projects — Florida coastal work and California public buildings — and neither is satisfied by UL 305 alone.

holds: UL/cUL listed panic hardware, or 3-hour fire rated exit hardware
ISO 9001, system certified by Underwriters Laboratories
ANSI/BHMA A156.2, A156.5 and A156.13 on other product lines
publishes: Meets 2010 ADA Standards 11B-309.4 and California Building Code 11B-309.4
Under 5 lbf push force to exit on accessible models
Centre-case latch throw 19mm (3/4"), top and bottom latches 16mm (5/8")
Door thickness 1-3/4" to 2-1/4", doors to 4' x 10'
notes: THE BENCHMARK FOR US. An Asian factory that holds exactly the certifications the American brands hold, and sells into the same specifications. Their in-house test facility complies with ISO 17025 and is certified by Intertek under a continuous re-inspection programme — that is the structure, not just the certificate.

holds: EN 1125 test report — Intertek Testing Services Shenzhen (Guangzhou branch), report 130722068GZU-001, 7 November 2013, model KD070/30-290
Tubular door lock durability test — Intertek, report 140306043GZU-001, 28 April 2014, model 607 SS ET
CE Certificate of Conformity to EN 1125:2008 — CELAB, Italy, 2010, panic exit device series
doesNotHold: ANSI/BHMA A156.3 of any grade — the client confirmed this outright and src/data/company.ts forbids any product record carrying an ANSI grade
Any California SFM or Miami-Dade approval
notes: The three reports are real and are Canton Hyland's own — the EN 1125 report names Canton Hyland as both applicant and manufacturer with HYLAND as the trade mark. The SCANS are withheld because both issuers restrict redistribution and require written approval before their name is used in advertising. Stating standard, issuer, report number, model and date is not redistribution and is already public on /certifications.

inProgress.note: 两个型号都送，不是二选一。两者都是自有模具（单套模具费 10 万元以上），改设计不需要求人，这是送检的前提条件。307 是阿里询盘第一，311 有 72 与 92 双中心距。这是一个已经做出的决定，可以在网站上写成「正在进行中」；在证书号下来之前，任何页面、任何材料都不得暗示我们已经持有 ANSI 或 UL —— UL Product iQ 与 BHMA认证产品目录都是公开可查的，规格制定者要把证号写进送审文件。
